setup_name: Short vol at low levels (short VIX contango products)
universe_filter: VIX ETPs in contango
conditions: VIX spot well below its long-run median (~16)
VIX futures at a premium to spot (contango)
entry_trigger: short the long-vol ETP / sell vol while vol is persistently low
target_or_exit: hold ~12 months to harvest roll-down
management: not specified
stated_edge: Contango roll-down: owning vol when it is low bleeds ~8%/yr; guest says shorting UVXY through calm 2017 earned about as much as top-ticking the 2020 spike.
stated_stats: anecdotal comparison only
data_needed: VIX spot/futures term structure; daily VXX/UVXY bars for a crude version
mcf_translation: Daily-bar position test: short VXX when VIX is below its trailing-1y 20th percentile and futures are in contango; hold N months with a vol stop. Not intraday.

setup_name: Skew-funded collar (rich calls)
universe_filter: BTC options when 25-delta call skew is extreme
conditions: 25d call vol far above 25d put vol (normal 5-8 vol pts; ~40 in Q4 2020)
entry_trigger: long spot, buy protective put, sell covered call ~3x as far OTM as the put at zero cost
target_or_exit: unwind when skew normalises (risk/reward from 1:3 toward 1:2)
management: can be levered because max loss is capped
stated_edge: Euphoric crypto buyers overpay for upside calls.
data_needed: crypto options chain / IV surface
mcf_translation: Not mappable to MCF bars.

setup_name: Crypto cash-and-carry / perp discount convergence
universe_filter: coins with large annualised basis or deeply discounted perps
conditions: annualised basis very high (30-40%) in euphoria, or perp at a large discount in a crash (e.g. SOL perp ~30% under spot after FTX)
entry_trigger: buy spot + sell future when basis is rich; or buy the discounted perp/long-dated future hedged with spot or perp
target_or_exit: hold to convergence/expiry while collecting funding
management: not specified
stated_edge: Leverage is costly inside crypto; basis reflects that cost and panics push it negative.
data_needed: crypto futures/perp prices and funding rates
mcf_translation: Not mappable.

setup_name: Put 1x2 ratio after a vol spike
instrument: options (crypto; concept applies to index options)
universe_filter: after a crash with put skew and overall IV historically high
conditions: implied vol spikes on a shock event
OTM put skew rich vs history
entry_trigger: buy 1 ATM put, sell 2 ~25-delta puts for zero cost or small credit; optionally buy a tiny far-OTM short-dated put as insurance
target_or_exit: hold ~3 days to a week as vol calms
management: leg in and scale over days
stated_edge: OTM options carry more vega per dollar of premium, so a vol calm-down crushes the short wings.
data_needed: options chain / IV history
mcf_translation: Not mappable; nearest equity analogue is a daily mean-reversion long after VIX spikes.

setup_name: Sell overpriced event vol (novel crypto events)
universe_filter: crypto events without pricing history (ETH merge, spot ETF decision)
conditions: 1-day implied vol inflates sharply into the event (e.g. 80% to 190%)
entry_trigger: sell short-dated implied vol into the event
target_or_exit: after the event when realised vol fails to show
management: not specified
stated_edge: No priors for novel events, so the market overprices disaster; vol stayed bid even after resolution.
data_needed: options IV
mcf_translation: Not mappable.

setup_name: News failure in a crowded market
instrument: futures (FX, bonds, index, commodities); applicable to liquid ETFs
time_of_day: daily close of the news day
universe_filter: markets where COT speculators are at a record/extreme net position on one side
conditions: speculator positioning extremely one-sided (COT)
a scheduled news release that should push price further in the crowded direction (e.g. bad data for a crowded short)
price initially moves with the news but then reverses and closes the day against it (e.g. opens/trades down, closes up)
entry_trigger: enter against the crowd at/near the close of the news-failure day
stop: beyond the extreme of the news-failure day (low for a long, high for a short)
target_or_exit: exit when positioning data returns to neutral
management: single fixed-risk entry, no adding; if stopped, re-enter only on a new news-failure day while still crowded
stated_edge: If bad news cannot push a crowded market further, there is no marginal seller left; trapped participants get squeezed through stops and moving averages.
stated_stats: win rate ~37-40%; risk 0.7% per trade; ~7-8% portfolio vol; ~15%/yr; one Swiss franc trade made ~7R
data_needed: COT positioning, economic calendar/news flags
mcf_translation: Daily-bar proxy on SPY/sector ETFs: after an N-day decline (e.g. close < 20d low region or RSI(14) < 30), on a macro release day (CPI/FOMC/NFP calendar) where the open or intraday low is below prior close but the close is above prior close (outside reversal), go long at close; stop below that day's low; exit on RSI back to 50 or 20d mean. Mirror for shorts.

setup_name: Correlation failure (news-failure subtype)
universe_filter: crowded market with a strong usual correlation to another market
conditions: positioning extreme
the correlated driver moves in the direction that should help the crowded side (e.g. dollar falls hard while gold is crowded long)
the crowded market initially reacts as expected then closes against it
entry_trigger: fade the crowd at the close of the failure day
target_or_exit: positioning back to neutral
management: same fixed risk
stated_edge: A cross-market move acts as news; failure to respond reveals exhausted buyers/sellers.
data_needed: COT data; daily bars for the paired market (e.g. UUP/GLD)
mcf_translation: Daily pair test: GLD up then closes below open on a day UUP falls >0.5%, after GLD near a 52-week high; short at close, stop at day high.

setup_name: Flat Earth random-entry ATR trailing-stop system
universe_filter: random ticker selection (Scrabble tiles, Ouija board) - deliberately no selection edge
conditions: direction = sign of the slope of the 13-period EMA on the daily chart (up -> long, down -> short)
entry_trigger: enter at market on selection
stop: initial trailing stop 2x ATR from price; 1% account risk per trade
target_or_exit: no target; exit only on trailing stop
management: once open profit reaches 2x ATR, tighten trail to 1.5x ATR; at 4x ATR profit, tighten to 1x ATR
stated_edge: Cutting the left tail of the outcome distribution and letting the right tail run makes even random entries profitable; trend direction filter adds a small tilt.
stated_stats: 100 trades Aug 2023-Jul 2024: +15% on $100k, win rate ~40%, profit factor 1.38, avg win/loss ~2:1; ~1/3 stopped out in first 5 days; longest losing streak 11; best trade ~7.5 ATR over ~45 days; did not beat S&P
mcf_translation: Daily bars: random symbol from universe each day (or every symbol as a baseline), side = sign(EMA13 today - EMA13 yesterday); ATR(14) trailing stop at 2x, tighten to 1.5x after +2 ATR MFE and 1x after +4 ATR MFE; size so 2 ATR = 1% equity. Use as a benchmark for MCF exit logic: compare any entry signal against random entries with the same exit.

setup_name: Multi-timeframe trend + strongest/weakest in group
universe_filter: strongest sector and industry group (for longs) or weakest (for shorts)
conditions: weekly, daily and 4-hour trends all aligned
sector and industry group strongest/weakest by relative strength
pick the single strongest/weakest stock in that group even if it has already moved a lot (e.g. short the worst semiconductor in the worst sector)
entry_trigger: not specified beyond alignment
target_or_exit: not specified
management: not specified
stated_edge: Returns come from market, sector, industry and stock trend aligning; the leader/laggard already shows the supply-demand imbalance, laggards are a bet on reversal.
data_needed: sector/industry classification
mcf_translation: Daily: rank sector ETFs by 1-3 month return; within top sector, pick stock with highest RS vs sector; require close > EMA on weekly and daily; combine with Flat Earth ATR trailing exit.

setup_name: Confluence reaction at options-exposure levels (one impulse per day)
time_of_day: pre-market to first 30 min of NY session; book closed by midday
universe_filter: NQ/ES only
conditions: mark the day's largest gamma/delta exposure strikes (recalculated each morning) as levels
note whether pre-market / first 30 min trades in bullish or bearish territory relative to those levels
confluence: VIX, DXY and the average of the Magnificent 7 moving the same way as the index (divergence means wait)
price reaches a level (not in the middle of the range between two levels)
planned stop and next-level target give at least 2-3R
entry_trigger: at the level, enter in the direction shown by live futures volume/delta (rejection -> fade toward prior level; squeeze through -> go with it toward the next level)
stop: beyond the level where the bias is invalidated
target_or_exit: next exposure level
management: take 50% at the next level, trail rest with ATR or SMA; usually 1 trade/day
stated_edge: Dealer hedging around high-exposure strikes makes price magnetise to or squeeze through those levels; options data gives retail more supply/demand info than futures alone.
data_needed: options open interest / gamma exposure by strike; futures volume delta
mcf_translation: Proxy on SPY/QQQ 5-min bars: replace GEX levels with prior-day high/low/close and round-number strikes; in 09:30-10:30, when price tags a level and the 5-min bar closes back inside with rvol > 1.5, fade toward the prior level; if a bar closes through with rvol > 2, go with it to the next level; require target/stop >= 2; 1 trade/day; half off at target, trail rest with ATR(14) on 5-min.

setup_name: Carry-trade crowding warning (rolling Sharpe of carry basket)
universe_filter: diversified basket of carry / short-volatility trades
conditions: rolling Sharpe ratio of the carry basket rises above ~1.0-1.5 (reached 1.45 in June 2024 before the August yen unwind)
entry_trigger: reduce short-vol/carry exposure or position for a vol spike once the threshold is crossed
target_or_exit: not specified
management: not specified
stated_edge: Easy risk-adjusted returns attract a crowd until no marginal buyer remains; a small shock then forces a large unwind.
stated_stats: guest says every Sharpe > 1 episode in ~30 years was followed by a drawdown
data_needed: FX carry returns; for an equity analogue, short-VIX ETP returns or SPY realised vol
mcf_translation: Regime filter: compute rolling 6-12 month Sharpe of a short-vol proxy (e.g. -VXX daily returns) or of SPY; when above 1.5, cut position size of MCF long-momentum setups or enable mean-reversion shorts. Test as a sizing overlay, not an entry.

setup_name: Correlation-break relative value after a macro event
universe_filter: pairs with long, stable, economically explainable correlation (e.g. China equities vs copper/iron ore/AUD)
conditions: major news moves one leg strongly
historically correlated leg fails to move by its usual beta
entry_trigger: trade the laggard toward its historical beta reaction (or spread trade)
target_or_exit: convergence to historical beta
management: drop pairs whose correlation decays over time
stated_edge: Not everyone can trade the primary asset, so flows spill into proxies with a lag; mispricing reverts.
data_needed: cross-asset daily data (FXI, COPX, EWA etc. are ETFs MCF could load)
mcf_translation: Daily ETF pairs: on days |z(return A)| > 2, compute expected B = beta*retA; if B residual < -1.5 sigma go long B next open, exit after 3-5 days or on convergence.

setup_name: Tight consolidation pivot in a long-term uptrend (Minervini/VCP style)
universe_filter: stocks in long-term uptrends (above rising 200-day MA / weekly uptrend), top 52-week relative strength vs market, ideally recent earnings and sales growth, leading growth groups
conditions: price in long-term uptrend (above 200-day MA, not near 52-week lows)
high 52-week relative strength rank
tight price consolidation forming a pivot point where right/wrong is known within days to two weeks
entry_trigger: buy as price moves through the pivot of the tight consolidation
stop: acceptable-risk price stop, mid-single-digit % (max 8-10%), average under 5%
target_or_exit: do not sell a strong stock for less than the average gain; take partial/all profits once at a multiple of risk and short-term extended, or when the stock posts its largest short-term move (parabolic) - then switch to trailing stop
management: sell non-performers that stall, keep the strongest; re-enter stopped names only after 1-2 days and a new settle
stated_edge: Timeless characteristics of the biggest historical winners (Livermore, Loeb, Darvas, O'Neill, Minervini); tight pivots give quick feedback and capital efficiency.
stated_stats: average loss under 5%; several triple-digit years claimed (2010, 2011, 2014, 2017, 2020)
data_needed: earnings/sales growth for the fundamental filter (optional)
mcf_translation: Daily bars: universe close > SMA200 and SMA200 rising, 52w RS rank > 80; base = last 10-20 days with range (high-low)/close < 10% and contracting ATR; enter on close above the base high with volume > 1.5x 50d avg; stop at base low capped at 8%; exit half at 2-3R, trail rest under 10/20-day MA; also exit if no progress within 10 days.

setup_name: Short intraday hyper-extension in small-cap gappers (timed entry)
time_of_day: model-specified one-minute entry window (not disclosed); flat by close
universe_filter: small caps gapping up strongly overnight on real price action (exclude buyouts/flat-line gaps); low institutional ownership; 10-40 candidates/day reduced to <=5 trades
conditions: large overnight gap up
parabolic / hyper-extended intraday move
two or three further undisclosed data filters
entry_trigger: short at the model's specified minute
stop: hard stop placed at a data-derived level (monitor fills since stops sometimes fail)
target_or_exit: intraday exit, scaled out to limit slippage; no overnight holds
management: risk reset daily to account size; capped size when own orders moved price
stated_edge: Retail-driven small-cap spikes follow repeating behavioural patterns that mean-revert intraday.
data_needed: small-cap universe with float, borrow/locate costs, 1-min bars
mcf_translation: Gap-up fade on 5-min bars: gap > 20-30%, price < $20, after the first 30-60 min short the first lower high below VWAP once the high of day is at least X ATR above VWAP; stop above HOD; cover by 15:55. Grid-search entry time and include locate fees in costs.

setup_name: Nasdaq-100 trend rotation (top-10 momentum with trailing stop)
time_of_day: orders computed after close, executed next day
universe_filter: Nasdaq-100 constituents
conditions: stock in an uptrend (e.g. above a long MA / breakout channel)
rank by highest rate of change (or dollar volume among trending names)
entry_trigger: hold the top 10 ranked trending stocks
target_or_exit: trailing stop
management: equal weighting; pair with a mean-reversion short system to offset trend give-back
stated_edge: Captures large bull trends (e.g. Nasdaq 2023); give-back drawdowns are offset by other systems.
data_needed: historical index membership to avoid survivorship bias
mcf_translation: Daily: universe NDX100; filter close > SMA200 (or 25-day Donchian high break); rank by 200-day ROC; hold top 10 equal weight, rebalance weekly; trailing stop e.g. 20-25% or 3x ATR.

setup_name: Mean-reversion short of overbought stocks (~5-day hold)
universe_filter: liquid US stocks
conditions: stock statistically overbought (e.g. several up days / high short-term RSI)
entry_trigger: sell short (limit order above prior close in his books' style)
stop: wide stop, only for disaster control
target_or_exit: cover on reversion to the mean, typically within ~5 days, or time exit
management: many small concurrent positions
stated_edge: Overbought stocks revert more than half the time within days; hedges trend-following give-back.
stated_stats: >50% probability of reversion within ~5 days (stated qualitatively)
mcf_translation: Daily: price > $5, avg dollar vol > $25M; RSI(3) > 90 and close > 3 consecutive up days; short next day at limit 3% above close; cover when RSI(3) < 50 or after 5 days; stop at +3 ATR.

setup_name: Mean-reversion long with trend filter
universe_filter: liquid stocks in long-term uptrend
conditions: long-term trend filter positive (stock and/or index)
sharp short-term pullback (strong, medium or weak pullback variants)
entry_trigger: buy the fear (limit below close)
stop: far stop only for risk control
target_or_exit: exit once price reverts through its mean, within a few days
management: trend filter keeps system flat in hard bear markets
stated_edge: Buying short-term fear in uptrends mean-reverts; negative skew (many small wins, rare large loss) must be expected.
stated_stats: Aug 2011 live losses ~2x backtest worst
mcf_translation: Daily: close > SMA200, SPY > SMA200; RSI(3) < 15 or 3-day drop > 10%; buy next day at limit 3-5% below close; exit on close > SMA5 or after 5 days.

setup_name: Sharp sell-off in a bull market (crash insurance system)
universe_filter: index / stocks while broad market is still in an uptrend
conditions: market in a bull trend
sudden 3-5 consecutive down days totaling several percent
entry_trigger: short (details not given)
target_or_exit: not specified
management: small allocation; expected to lose slightly most years
stated_edge: Covers the gap where trend-long and MR-long lose, MR-short is flat and trend-short has not triggered yet.
data_needed: exact rules undisclosed
mcf_translation: Daily: SPY > SMA200 and SPY falls 3 days in a row with cumulative drop > 3% -> short SPY next open, exit on first up close or after 5 days; evaluate as a portfolio hedge for MCF long setups.

setup_name: Buy confirmed merger announcement below eventual arb spread
time_of_day: seconds to ~15 minutes after the deal press release
universe_filter: targets of a definitive cash merger announcement from a credible source
conditions: definitive deal price known (e.g. $3.15 cash)
fast money has bought the rumor and is taking profits well below the price large arb funds will pay given the annualised spread
deal risk understood (antitrust, FDA, incorporation state)
entry_trigger: buy aggressively while the stock trades well below the expected arb level (e.g. 2.40-2.75 vs expected ~3.0+)
target_or_exit: sell into the large merger-arb funds' bids once they arrive (~10-15 min)
management: size up to the confidence level; caution in thin names
stated_edge: Large arb funds need minutes to read the release and commit; small trader with deal expertise can price the spread faster.
data_needed: real-time news/press release feed, M&A deal database, tick data
mcf_translation: Not mappable to MCF bar data.

setup_name: Fade over-reaction to already-expected or toothless deal news
universe_filter: names on his tracked deal list
conditions: headline is already priced in (e.g. EU approval pre-reported) or weak (tier-2 activist raising bid for a company incorporated in a target-friendly state like Maryland)
stock gaps up beyond the level justified by the news
entry_trigger: short into the spike
target_or_exit: cover as late readers realise the news is not new (30 s to 30 min)
management: only trade if the move is large enough
stated_edge: Machines and casual traders buy any positive keyword; context about what remains (e.g. HSR approval) or legal structure is not priced.
data_needed: news feed, deal database
mcf_translation: Not mappable.

setup_name: Follow-through day (market bottom confirmation)
instrument: index (Nasdaq Composite, S&P 500) - gate for stock exposure
universe_filter: Nasdaq or S&P 500 in a correction/downtrend
conditions: index in a downtrend
day 1 = first up day after the decline (rally attempt); count days while the day-1 low holds
on day 4-7 (valid later too, e.g. day 17 or 23) the index closes up at least 1.75% on volume greater than the prior day (S&P uses NYSE volume)
entry_trigger: follow-through day confirms new uptrend -> begin buying leading stocks
stop: rally attempt fails if day-1 low is undercut
target_or_exit: n/a (regime signal)
management: judge quality by number and stage of leaders setting up; not every FTD leads to a bull run
stated_edge: Every new bull market in history was preceded by an FTD (backtested at O'Neil); days 2-3 rallies in bear markets often fail.
stated_stats: necessary but not sufficient condition
data_needed: NYSE composite volume for the S&P variant (can use SPY volume)
mcf_translation: Daily SPY/QQQ: define correction as close > 8% below 52w high; day1 = first up close; FTD = on day >=4 close/prev -1 >= 1.75% and volume > prior day, with day1 low intact. Use as regime switch to enable MCF long setups and measure forward 20/60-day returns.

setup_name: Relative-strength line new high ahead of price + consolidation pivot
universe_filter: institutional-quality growth leaders (quarterly EPS/sales growth >= 25%, ideally triple digit), top RS in leading growth groups; ~200 names out of ~12k
conditions: RS line (stock / S&P) makes a new high before price does
tight 'consolidation pivot' earlier on the right side of a base (Weinstein-style), not the textbook base breakout
entry_trigger: buy through the consolidation pivot
target_or_exit: scale out on MA breaks (see MA exit rule)
management: build exposure progressively only as positions work
stated_edge: RS leading price shows institutional accumulation before the breakout; works 'as well today as in 1890' per guest.
data_needed: EPS/sales growth for full CANSLIM filter
mcf_translation: Daily: RS = close/SPY close; signal when RS hits 52w (or 250d) high while price is still below its 52w high and within 10% of it; tight 5-10 day range < 8%; buy close above range high; stop 7%.

setup_name: Moving-average two-day undercut exit
time_of_day: end of day, except intraday on day-2 undercut
universe_filter: open winning positions
conditions: choose the MA the stock historically respects (10-day SMA, 21-day SMA / 23-day EMA, 50-day SMA / 65-day EMA)
entry_trigger: n/a (exit rule)
stop: day 1: close below the MA -> hold; day 2: if price undercuts day-1 low, sell immediately intraday
target_or_exit: sell 1/3-1/2 on break of the 10-day, remainder on break of the 21-day (via the same two-day rule)
management: enforce stops near the close in bull markets because late-day recoveries are common
stated_edge: Gives the trend the benefit of the doubt; one-day closes below an MA often recover in strong markets.
mcf_translation: Exit overlay on daily bars for any MCF swing long: flag on close < SMA21; exit on next day if low < flagged day's low (use stop at that low), else clear flag on close back above.

setup_name: Fade spike into predetermined extension level (scaled scalp)
time_of_day: around volatility events and alerts; not fixed
universe_filter: his 8 liquid products
conditions: fast spike (large single 5/15-min candle) reaching a predetermined Fibonacci-expansion 'extreme' level
speed at which the level is hit signals volatility
entry_trigger: fade the spike (mostly short) and add size in quick increments as it extends
stop: money-based close-all on total P&L; no hard stop
target_or_exit: take profit the first time it is offered (a fraction of the spike, e.g. 20-30 pips)
management: scaling in = averaging into short-term pain; average and day-trade variants hold for 2-8 h with smaller size
stated_edge: Spikes in a bull market leave wicks and pull back quickly as profit-taking hits; extremes always retrace somewhat.
stated_stats: about 80% of trades are shorts; a couple of these per week can make the week
data_needed: his proprietary level definitions
mcf_translation: 5-min SPY/QQQ: when a single 5-min bar range > 3x ATR(20) up-move reaches the 1.618 extension of the prior swing, short next bar; target 38% retrace of the spike bar; time stop 15 min; note averaging-in is not MCF-compatible without explicit max size.

setup_name: Multi-timeframe overbought failure / right-shoulder entry
conditions: overbought readings on several timeframes at once
market fails to make a new high (lower high = right shoulder)
sellers start to come in (e.g. upticks/downticks, advance-decline turning)
entry_trigger: sell short as the lower high turns down (mirror: buy the higher low after a low that holds)
stop: above the prior relative high (idea invalidated by a new high)
target_or_exit: hold until oversold on the larger timeframe (he admits exiting too early)
management: patience on entry and exit
stated_edge: Waiting for timeframe alignment and a failed retest avoids picking absolute tops/bottoms while keeping a tight logical stop.
data_needed: NYSE tick / breadth for confirmation (optional)
mcf_translation: SPY 5-min: RSI(14) > 70 on 5-min and 60-min within last N bars; after a swing high, a lower swing high forms and a 5-min close breaks the intervening swing low -> short; stop above the lower high or the main high; exit when 60-min RSI < 30 or at session close.

setup_name: Far-OTM ES credit spreads ('set and done')
universe_filter: S&P 500 futures options
conditions: sell bull put spreads ~10% below price (further when VIX is high), sometimes bear call spreads
expiry ~2-6 weeks (shorter in fast markets)
total max loss deployed <= 50% of capital
entry_trigger: open new cycle when previous expires or on volatility spikes
stop: adjust/roll or close if price approaches the short strike; close most positions before major scheduled event risk
target_or_exit: let theta decay to expiry
management: bias the put/call mix by macro event view
stated_edge: Variance risk premium; S&P rarely moves 10% within a month; premium more than doubles when VIX doubles.
stated_stats: claims ~36% in flat 2022-23 year; ~2x S&P 2022-2024 per guest; target 10-20%/yr
data_needed: options chain / IV history
mcf_translation: Not mappable to bar data (requires option prices).

setup_name: Mean reversion on commodity-linked FX cross (e.g. CAD/NOK)
universe_filter: crosses of economies with common fundamental driver (oil exporters CAD/NOK; commodity/risk-on AUD/NOK, AUD/CAD)
conditions: price deviates far from its moving average (signal from RSI / Bollinger / Williams %R-type oscillator)
annual discretionary check that the fundamental linkage still holds
entry_trigger: enter toward the mean on signal; first third of size, add second and third tranches as deviation increases
target_or_exit: take profit at the average price over the lookback (the mean)
management: fixed size, no compounding; re-entry only on a fresh signal after price returns to the mean
stated_edge: Both currencies track the same driver (oil), so the cross is a mean-reverting series; NOK is too illiquid for large institutions to arb away.
stated_stats: about 10 trades/yr, average hold ~1 month, high hit rate, drawdowns up to ~20%
data_needed: FX daily data; equity analogue would need ETF pairs
mcf_translation: Equity-ETF analogue on daily bars: pair of fundamentally linked ETFs (e.g. XLE vs XOP, EWC vs NORW, GDX vs GLD) - z-score of log ratio vs 60-day mean; enter at |z|>2 (1/3), 2.5 (2/3), 3 (full); exit at z=0; stop at |z|>4 or fixed 10%.

setup_name: Risk-neutral pyramiding into trends ('progressive exposure')
universe_filter: trending, low-media-attention markets (sugar, cotton, cocoa, corn)
conditions: market breaking out / trending in your direction
initial risk fixed in dollars (e.g. $250-500 on a small account)
entry_trigger: initial unit on trend breakout; add units as the market moves in favor
stop: move stop to breakeven once trade is up a few hundred dollars; with each added unit, raise stops so total open risk never exceeds the original unit's risk
target_or_exit: no fixed target; trailing equity stop (about the original risk amount, loosened once well in profit)
management: re-enter at higher prices if stopped out and trend resumes
stated_edge: Asymmetric payoff: 30-40% of trends continue, and pyramided size makes those large while losses stay at one risk unit.
stated_stats: suggests ~40% accuracy with ~3:1 payoff early; e.g. caught sugar 9->18
mcf_translation: Daily stock/ETF test: entry on 20-day high close; initial stop 2 ATR; when price advances 1 ATR, move stop to breakeven and add a unit; each later +1 ATR add a unit and raise all stops so aggregate risk <= initial risk; trail final stop at 3 ATR below highest close. Compare against single-unit version.

setup_name: Pre-earnings implied-vol run-up
time_of_day: enter ~2 weeks before earnings; exit before the release
universe_filter: stocks with weekly options and upcoming earnings; IV below its usual pre-earnings level
conditions: IV tends to ramp starting ~2 weeks before the report
entry_trigger: buy long straddle/strangle or ATM calendar (front expiry = earnings week)
stop: exit if IV is not rising at its historical day-over-day pace (e.g. after ~4 days)
target_or_exit: close before the announcement
management: many small positions across the earnings season
stated_edge: Documented IV expansion into earnings (research on SSRN).
data_needed: options IV history, earnings calendar
mcf_translation: Not mappable to bar data.

setup_name: Post-release IV crush short strangle
time_of_day: enter 5-10 min before the close ahead of an after-hours report
universe_filter: liquid earnings names
conditions: size so that a move equal to the largest of the prior 12 earnings moves (and a larger one) loses < 1% of portfolio
entry_trigger: sell strangle (~30 delta) before the release; add a long upside wing on tech names
target_or_exit: buy back after the release once IV collapses
management: convert to wide iron condor if worst-case loss too large
stated_edge: Implied move typically exceeds the realised move; IV collapses after the event.
data_needed: options chain, earnings calendar
mcf_translation: Not mappable to bar data.

setup_name: Post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD)
universe_filter: stocks just reported earnings
conditions: strong beat (or miss) quality
breakout up (or breakdown) on the post-earnings day
entry_trigger: trade in the direction of the earnings reaction after the release
stop: level that would also stop a stock trade (priced into option via alert)
target_or_exit: not specified; can repeat into the next quarter
management: not specified
stated_edge: Known academic anomaly: prices continue drifting in the direction of the surprise.
data_needed: earnings dates and surprise data
mcf_translation: Daily/5-min: on earnings-gap days with gap > 5% and close in top 25% of day range and rvol > 3, buy next day if price holds above day-1 VWAP/low; exit after 20 days or on close below day-1 low. Needs an earnings-date flag (can proxy with gap + extreme volume).

setup_name: Volume-gated opening breakout (relative cumulative volume filter)
instrument: futures (NQ, ES); applicable to SPY/QQQ and stocks
time_of_day: first 15 minutes of the NY session
universe_filter: liquid index futures
conditions: compute volume traded by the end of the first 15-min bar as a % of the 100-day average daily volume (or of the average first-15-min volume)
if participation is low (example given ~14% of normal), breakouts are disabled; switch to mean-reversion
if participation is high (several times normal), breakouts are enabled and size can be increased
entry_trigger: break of a level / opening range in the direction of positive (negative) delta when volume gate passes
target_or_exit: asymmetric targets of 3R+; average hold ~6 minutes, max same session
management: size up 2-5x when relative volume is high, cut to 1/3-1/2 in low-volume regimes
stated_edge: Breakouts need sustained aggressive buying; without volume they fail and mean reversion dominates.
stated_stats: simulated fund ~+30% YTD, Sharpe > 3, Sortino > 9, max DD ~0.2% (claimed)
data_needed: volume delta for the confirmation component
mcf_translation: 5-min SPY/QQQ: rvol_15 = volume(09:30-09:45)/avg volume(09:30-09:45 over 100d). If rvol_15 >= 1.5: trade 15-min ORB breakout (stop at OR midpoint, target 3R or EOD). If rvol_15 < 0.8: fade OR extremes toward VWAP instead. Compare vs unfiltered ORB.

setup_name: Absorption fade at a breakout level
universe_filter: liquid futures
conditions: price pushes above a key level on abnormal positive delta (aggressive buying)
the 1-minute bar fails to close above the level (resting limit sellers absorb)
entry_trigger: short on the failed close back below the level
target_or_exit: asymmetric target (3R+)
management: mirror for absorption of selling at support
stated_edge: When heavy aggressive buying cannot hold price above a level, passive sellers dominate; normal selling then moves price easily.
data_needed: tick/footprint delta; MCF could proxy with volume and bar shape
mcf_translation: 1/5-min proxy: bar trades above prior-day high or OR high with volume > 3x avg but closes below the level in lower third of its range -> short next bar; stop above bar high; target 3R or VWAP.

setup_name: Asset-revesting rotation (trend + cross-asset sentiment, vol-scaled)
time_of_day: signal at daily close, execute next open
universe_filter: a short hierarchy of liquid assets ordered by volatility
conditions: asset in a confirmed uptrend (multiple cycles aligned)
cross-asset sentiment supportive: majority of risk-off assets (gold, utilities, staples, bonds) falling when buying equities
otherwise move to the next slower asset, or cash
entry_trigger: buy the strongest qualifying asset at next open
target_or_exit: first target at 61.8% and second at 100% Fibonacci extension of the prior swing; trail remainder
management: allocation scaled by volatility (e.g. 60% invested / 40% cash in volatile markets); trims at targets
stated_edge: Stay in whatever is trending, avoid big drawdowns, compound 10-15%/yr with few trades.
stated_stats: 5-12 trades/yr; claims exit before 2025 ~20% drawdown
mcf_translation: Daily: candidates SPY, QQQ, TLT, UUP, cash (BIL). Each week/day rank by 3-6 month momentum among those above their 100/200-day MA; risk-on filter: XLU/SPY and GLD/SPY ratios below their 50-day MA for equities. Allocation = min(1, target_vol / 20d realised vol). Exit on close below 50-day MA or trailing 3 ATR.

setup_name: Defensive-sector lead warning
universe_filter: S&P sectors
conditions: utilities (XLU) and consumer staples (XLP) rally strongly and outperform SPY for several days to two weeks while SPY is near highs
entry_trigger: reduce equity exposure / prepare for a leg down
target_or_exit: n/a
management: confirm with other risk-off assets (gold, bonds)
stated_edge: Money rotates to necessities before broad selling.
mcf_translation: Daily overlay: if 10-day return of (XLU+XLP)/2 minus SPY > +3% and SPY within 3% of its 52w high, halve size of new long entries; test forward 10/20-day SPY returns after signal.

setup_name: Liquidity sweep of an old high/low with close back inside
universe_filter: markets with a clear higher-timeframe bias
conditions: price runs an obvious prior extreme (previous day/week/month/year low or high) where stops cluster
price closes back inside (above the old low / below the old high)
higher-timeframe narrative agrees with the reversal direction
entry_trigger: enter in the reversal direction after the close back inside
target_or_exit: opposite-side liquidity / higher-timeframe target; often exits by lunch on time-of-day feel
management: add to winners in clean trends; take a single entry per idea
stated_edge: Breakout chasers get trapped below old lows; larger players buy their stops, producing mean reversion.
mcf_translation: 5-min stocks/ETFs: in 09:30-11:00, if low < prior-day low (or prior-week low) and a 5-min bar then closes back above that level, buy next bar; stop below sweep low; target prior-day high or 2R; filter with daily trend (close > SMA50 for longs). Mirror for highs.

setup_name: Session-range sweep reversal (Asian/London range then NY)
universe_filter: FX majors, NQ/ES
conditions: mark Asian-session (and London) high/low
price takes out one side of the range
higher-timeframe bias points the other way
entry_trigger: fade the sweep, entering opposite the breakout
target_or_exit: opposite side of the session range / daily objective
management: skip if no strong reaction at the level; wait for more information
stated_edge: Breakout traders entering on session-range breaks provide liquidity for the true move.
data_needed: extended-hours bars for the overnight range
mcf_translation: Stocks: use pre-market high/low (04:00-09:30) as the 'session range'; if regular-session price breaks pre-market low in first 30 min then reclaims it on a 5-min close, go long; stop at new low; target pre-market high. Requires extended-hours data.

setup_name: FOMC-week day filter
universe_filter: all
conditions: FOMC announcement on Wednesday
entry_trigger: stand aside or trade tiny on Monday/Tuesday; take the week's directional trade after the release (Wed afternoon-Thu)
target_or_exit: n/a
management: applies similarly around NFP weeks
stated_edge: Pre-event days chop as large players wait; trend emerges after digestion of the news.
data_needed: FOMC calendar
mcf_translation: Calendar filter for MCF setups: compare setup expectancy on FOMC-week Mon/Tue vs Thu/Fri vs normal days; disable entries on pre-FOMC days if expectancy is worse.

setup_name: Post-momentum tight flag breakout near 8/21 EMA
universe_filter: IBD RS rating >= 90; dollar volume >= $20-100M/day in mature themes ($5-10M in young themes); prefer price > $10; multiple stocks from same theme in scans; fast sales growth (20-40%+) or strong story
conditions: market trend model green (index MAs trending up, rising count of new highs, rising % of stocks above 200-day MA)
stock already made an initial momentum move of ~50-70%
pullback/sideways consolidation that tightens around the 8- or 21-day EMA with volume drying up
sister stocks also setting up
entry_trigger: buy the breakout from the tight consolidation (flag / base pivot)
stop: tight stop below the consolidation; risk 0.5-1% of capital (up to 1.5% on top conviction)
target_or_exit: hold winners weeks to months; sell losers within days
management: max 3 positions per theme; equity-curve based exposure cuts
stated_edge: Institutional accumulation shows in relative strength and volume; second leg after a power move with supported pullback.
stated_stats: claims ~+50% in May 2025; 5-7 losses in a row considered normal
data_needed: fundamental/RS rating data (can compute RS from price)
mcf_translation: Daily: RS rank >= 90 (12m return percentile), 60d return >= 50%; last 5-15 bars range < 12% and close within 3% of EMA21; volume 5d avg < 0.7x 50d avg; buy close above consolidation high with vol > 1.5x; stop at consolidation low (cap 8%); exit on close below EMA21 (two-day rule) or 3R trail; regime gate: SPY > SMA50 > SMA200 and % of universe above SMA200 rising.

setup_name: Equity-curve exposure governor
universe_filter: own account equity
conditions: equity closes back inside its Bollinger band after weeks above the upper band
or equity below its 20-day MA
or single-day portfolio loss > 4%
entry_trigger: reduce gross exposure / remove margin; after -4% day exit losing positions quickly
target_or_exit: restore exposure once equity regains its MA20
management: rules-based to override overconfidence
stated_edge: Hot streaks precede sloppiness; equity-curve signals are an objective brake.
mcf_translation: Apply to MCF simulated equity: halve position size when strategy equity < SMA20(equity) or after a -4% day; test drawdown vs CAGR impact.

setup_name: Pre-market mean reversion to prior close on weak news
instrument: US stocks (small caps, Chinese small caps)
universe_filter: pre-market movers with volume; companies with history of dilution/offerings or promotional news; Chinese small caps (short bias)
conditions: stock up (e.g. ~5%+) pre-market on news judged non-material or promotional
long-term chart in decline / recent offerings
liquidity sufficient for the size
entry_trigger: short on offers near the ask into irrational buying
stop: quick exit when wrong (small fixed loss)
target_or_exit: cover near prior close (flat on the day)
management: rarely carry into the open; size limited by pre-market liquidity
stated_edge: Thin pre-market books let uninformed buyers push prices; promotional PRs often precede offerings.
stated_stats: ~83% win rate; many tiny winners
data_needed: pre-market bars, news classification, dilution history
mcf_translation: Needs extended-hours bars: at 08:00-09:25, stocks with pre-market gap +5-20% and pre-market volume > 2x their avg pre-market volume, no earnings flag, price < $10 and prior 6m return < -50% -> short, target prior close, stop at pre-market high +1%; close by 09:29.

setup_name: Pre-market strong-news momentum (episodic pivot early entry)
universe_filter: stocks with material news (earnings beats, big contracts)
conditions: pre-market volume already a multiple (e.g. 3x) of full-day average volume
news type historically associated with large follow-through
entry_trigger: buy in pre-market, before regular-session price discovery completes
stop: wider stop needed if held into the volatile open
target_or_exit: sell into regular-session strength
management: he mostly avoids holding into the open; noted as best entry for swing longs
stated_edge: Pre-market often has not fully priced strong news; regular-session volume arrives later.
data_needed: pre-market volume and news/earnings flags
mcf_translation: Extended hours: if pre-market volume by 09:00 > 1x 20d avg daily volume and gap > 5% with earnings flag, buy at 09:00 price, exit at 10:00 or on break of pre-market low.

setup_name: Index-inclusion anticipation (decayed edge)
universe_filter: likely S&P 500 additions/deletions
conditions: predict which stocks will be added to (or removed from) a major index
entry_trigger: long likely additions, short likely deletions before index funds rebalance
target_or_exit: around the rebalance date
management: not specified
stated_edge: Forced index-fund buying/selling; guest says it worked for a few years then stopped once widely known.
stated_stats: described as no longer working
data_needed: historical index change announcements
mcf_translation: Event study on daily bars around S&P inclusion announcements (if an index-change calendar is available); mainly useful as an example of edge decay - test by sub-period.

setup_name: Overextended run into prior-day level + tail-bar reversal
time_of_day: 09:50-10:30 ET (after first ~20 min, within first hour)
universe_filter: ~10 liquid large caps with tight spreads
conditions: price runs into an obvious daily level: prior-day high (for shorts) or low (for longs), ideally one that produced a violent reversal before
run is overextended: many consecutive same-color 5-min bars (e.g. 8-15)
a reversal tail bar (topping tail / bottoming tail) forms at the level
market not in a strong trend day; 20/200 MA spread not extremely wide against the trade
entry_trigger: short at the break of the tail bar's low (long: break of bottoming tail's high); refine on 1-2 min chart
stop: beyond the tail bar extreme; fixed dollar max loss
target_or_exit: first target ~1/3 retracement of the prior run (minimum 2R); trail remainder bar-by-bar or with MA while large bars continue; out by end of first hour
management: allow one re-entry if shaken out and a new tail bar forms; constant size
stated_edge: Most first tests of an obvious prior high fail; overextended moves into levels snap back.
stated_stats: win rate ~30-35%, R:R 3-4:1 targeted; up-year trend 2022-2024
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: between 09:50 and 10:30, if price touches prior-day high after >=6 of last 8 bars green and close > VWAP + 1.5 ATR(5m), and current bar is a topping tail (upper wick >= 50% of range, close in lower half), short on break of its low; stop above its high; target = entry - (run_size/3), min 2R; flat at 10:30-11:00. Mirror long at prior-day low.

setup_name: Elephant bar 'gift zone' re-entry
universe_filter: same large caps
conditions: at a reversal location, a wide-range bar much larger than prior bars ('elephant bar') ignites the move
price retraces back into the body of that bar
entry_trigger: enter in the bar's direction on the retrace into the bar (gift zone)
stop: beyond the elephant bar's extreme (more aggressive: invalid if >80% of the bar is retraced)
target_or_exit: same 1/3-retracement target of the prior move, min 2R
management: about half of elephant bars give a retrace entry; the rest run without you
stated_edge: Violent bars mark origin of institutional demand; a retest gives a lower-risk entry.
stated_stats: retrace occurs ~50% of the time (his stats)
mcf_translation: 5-min: bar range >= 2.5x average of prior 10 ranges and close in top 25% (long) after a down run at a daily level; place limit at 50% of bar; stop at bar low; cancel if not filled in 6 bars; target 2-3R.

setup_name: Trap-zone avoidance filter
universe_filter: any
conditions: define trap zone as the high-low range of the prior day's last 45 minutes (or any tight consolidation)
entry_trigger: no new entries while price is inside the trap zone; trade only from its edges or outside it
target_or_exit: n/a
management: filter for other setups
stated_edge: Inside consolidation, two-sided noise gives no edge.
mcf_translation: Filter: compute high/low of 15:15-16:00 bars of prior day; suppress MCF intraday entries while price is inside that band; compare expectancy with/without filter.

setup_name: Box / inner-wedge breakout
time_of_day: first 2-3 hours of the session for day trades
universe_filter: index futures; leading stocks for swings
conditions: prior trend (higher highs/lows) ends and price contracts into a range ('box')
inside the box a tighter wedge forms (lower highs, higher lows)
higher-timeframe trend aligned (above 9 MA / 20 EMA)
entry_trigger: enter on the break of the inner wedge, before the full box break (or buy the last pullback to the box bottom in a bullish structure)
stop: below the wedge's lower boundary (uptrend case)
target_or_exit: half at 1.2-1.5R, quarter at ~3R, runner with stop at breakeven; runners can become multi-day (he cites ~800 NQ points)
management: max 2-3 trades/day; one re-entry after a false break
stated_edge: Contraction stores energy; entering at the inner wedge cuts risk vs the obvious box break, allowing larger size for the same R.
stated_stats: claims ~200% in 2022
mcf_translation: 5-min SPY/QQQ or stocks: after a 30-60 min up-leg, detect a box (N>=6 bars, range < 1.5 ATR) and within it a wedge (declining highs, rising lows over last 4-6 bars); buy break of wedge upper line; stop below wedge low; scale-out 50% at 1.5R, 25% at 3R, rest trail at breakeven/EMA20.

setup_name: Hourly pullback after a fresh multi-week range breakout
universe_filter: indices/leaders that just broke out of a multi-week (e.g. 2-month) consolidation to new highs
conditions: daily uptrend: above daily 9 MA / 20 EMA
fresh breakout from a multi-week contraction
2-3 day pullback forming an hourly retracement
entry_trigger: buy when the hourly pullback ends, timed with a 2/5-min trigger (mean-reversion rules met)
stop: below the pullback low (tight, lower timeframe)
target_or_exit: trend continuation; exit when price closes ~2 days below the 20 EMA
management: size up in 'A+' environments (all timeframes aligned)
stated_edge: After a fresh range breakout, every pullback tends to be bought for 1-2 weeks.
mcf_translation: Daily+60m: SPY/QQQ closes at a 40-day high after a 30-60 day range (range < 8%); within next 10 days, when price pulls back 2-3 days to the 20 EMA on the daily / 60m RSI(14) < 40, buy on first 5-min close above VWAP; stop below pullback low; exit on 2 consecutive daily closes below EMA20.

setup_name: Two lower lows + failed breakdown bottom
universe_filter: S&P 500 / Nasdaq in a downtrend
conditions: downtrend along a declining 9 MA has made a second lower low (his studies: ~80% of trends end after the second extension)
breadth / leading stocks diverge (not making new lows)
a daily contraction attempts to break lower and fails
entry_trigger: go long when the breakdown fails and price reclaims the contraction
target_or_exit: trend reversal
management: same structure used to call tops
stated_edge: Third extensions are rare (~20%); failed breakdown with positive divergences marks seller exhaustion (cited April 2025 and March 2020).
stated_stats: ~80% of trends end after a second higher high / lower low (his own study)
data_needed: breadth data for the divergence part
mcf_translation: Weekly/daily SPY: count swing lower lows below a falling 9-week MA; after the 2nd lower low, if price breaks a 4-6 day contraction low intraday but closes back inside, buy next open; stop at that low; measure 20/60-day forward return.

setup_name: Relative strength vs SPY with daily-chart alignment
universe_filter: liquid large caps
conditions: market first: SPY trending (not a low-probability trading environment); regime long while SPY above its daily 50 SMA
stock relatively strong vs SPY intraday (e.g. green while SPY down ~1%) for longs (relatively weak for shorts)
daily chart: above 50/100/200 SMAs, not overextended from EMA15, held earnings gap, near all-time high (no overhead supply)
entry_trigger: enter with the trend once relative strength is confirmed (e.g. holding above a broken SMA/level)
stop: mental stop at a support level / SPY regime line
target_or_exit: mostly within a day; hold longer than instinct says (walkaway analysis)
management: balance longs vs shorts in the book; can add to winners
stated_edge: Relative strength reveals institutional support; RS stocks fall less and rise more than SPY, giving a buffer.
mcf_translation: 5-min: RS = stock % change since open minus beta*SPY % change; when SPY down >0.5% and stock RS > +1% at 10:30, with daily close > SMA50/100/200, (close-EMA15)/ATR < 2, within 5% of 52w high -> buy; stop below morning low; exit at close or next day. Shorts mirror. Regime: only longs when SPY > SMA50.

setup_name: Bull put spread below two support levels
universe_filter: liquid stocks with clear support
conditions: short strike below at least two independent support levels (e.g. 50-day SMA and a trend line / gap candle low)
~2 weeks to expiry
entry_trigger: sell OTM put credit spread (e.g. ~$1 credit on $5 wide)
target_or_exit: let expire or close if both supports break
management: only on stocks you would accept owning
stated_edge: Two layers of support rarely both break within the expiry window.
stated_stats: ~370-400 tracked trades with ~91% success (claimed)
data_needed: option prices for P&L; probability part testable on daily bars
mcf_translation: Daily-bar probability test: frequency that a stock closes below min(SMA50, trendline/gap low) within 10 trading days given it is above both at entry; options P&L requires chain data.

setup_name: Front-run mechanical VIX ETP end-of-day rebalancing
time_of_day: into the daily rebalance window near the close
universe_filter: VIX futures when leveraged/inverse VIX ETPs hold a large share of open interest (2015-2018 cited ~80-90%)
conditions: large move in VIX futures during the day
leveraged (2x) and inverse ETPs must mechanically buy after up-moves and sell after down-moves to restore exposure at a known time
entry_trigger: position in the direction of the required rebalancing ahead of the window
target_or_exit: exit into the rebalance flow
management: size up while the inefficiency persists
stated_edge: Predictable, time-specific forced flows that everyone could calculate in advance.
stated_stats: profitable for a period; inefficiency faded after products shrank/blew up (Feb 2018)
data_needed: VIX futures intraday data and ETP holdings history
mcf_translation: Proxy on VXX/UVXY 5-min: if VXX up > X% by 15:30, buy at 15:30 and sell at close (and inverse); test by year to show decay. Similar logic could apply to leveraged equity ETF rebalancing (TQQQ/SQQQ) into the close.

setup_name: Volatility squeeze breakout in an uptrend
universe_filter: liquid, tight-spread stocks (no small caps/penny stocks) in uptrends; scanner for Bollinger-inside-Keltner squeezes
conditions: stock trending up, riding the 10 and 21 EMA
compression: Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channels, volume drying up
MACD bullish cross
entry_trigger: buy during compression or on the breakout with a volume spike
stop: position sized by setup grade (1-5% risk); exit if trend fails
target_or_exit: sell into strength at the next key resistance within 0-5 days (also benefits from IV expansion)
management: usually one new trade per day; trail with EMAs if holding longer
stated_edge: Buying low-volatility consolidation in a trend captures both the breakout and vol expansion.
data_needed: options data for option P&L (stock-level test is fine)
mcf_translation: Daily/hourly: universe price>$20, ADV>$50M; close > EMA10 > EMA21 rising; BB(20,2) inside KC(20,1.5) for >=5 bars; volume 5d avg < 0.8x 50d; enter on close above 10-day high with volume > 1.5x; exit at +2 ATR or after 5 days; stop at EMA21.

setup_name: Overextended daily reversal (upper Bollinger + bearish RSI divergence)
instrument: US stocks (via short-dated puts; calls for the bullish mirror)
universe_filter: stocks after a large, fast run-up (or gap-down slow bleed for the long mirror)
conditions: daily price tags/exceeds upper Bollinger Band
bearish RSI divergence (price higher high, RSI lower high)
very extended run, ideally high volatility
entry_trigger: buy puts when signals align
stop: position size limit; (early version let losers expire)
target_or_exit: sell at nearest support within 2-3 days
management: about one trade per month in the fund version
stated_edge: Exhausted moves revert; puts gain extra from vol expansion on sharp drops.
stated_stats: anecdotal (one 6000% put trade)
mcf_translation: Daily: close > upper BB(20,2), 20d return > 30%, RSI(14) lower high vs prior swing high while price higher high; short next open, cover at 20d SMA or after 3 days; stop above signal-day high.

setup_name: 0DTE pre-market high/low break-and-retest
instrument: SPY, QQQ, blue chips (0DTE calls/puts or debit spreads)
universe_filter: SPY, QQQ, mega caps
conditions: mark pre-market high and low
price breaks a level on high volume / expanding ATR
retest of the broken level holds; RSI / DSS momentum confirm
entry_trigger: enter on the successful retest in the breakout direction
target_or_exit: 5-15 minute hold
management: single-leg or debit spread
stated_edge: Pre-market extremes are widely watched; confirmed retests show acceptance.
stated_stats: described as the fund's second-best strategy (no numbers)
data_needed: pre-market high/low (extended hours bars)
mcf_translation: 1/5-min SPY/QQQ: after 09:30, first close above pre-market high with volume > 1.5x avg, then a pullback bar whose low holds within 0.05% of the level -> long; stop below level; exit after 15 min or +1.5R.

setup_name: SPX 0DTE butterfly at expected pin (gamma/charm levels)
universe_filter: SPX
conditions: dealer gamma/charm heat maps indicate a likely pin strike
entry_trigger: buy 5-10 point wide butterfly centered on the expected pin
target_or_exit: close/expire near pin
management: small premium per trade
stated_edge: Higher-order Greek flows (charm etc.) pull price toward key strikes into expiry.
stated_stats: claimed ~52% win rate, average win ~950% of premium, losers -50 to -100% (self-reported)
data_needed: SPX options chain, dealer positioning
mcf_translation: Not mappable to bar data.

setup_name: Gapper post-open narrowing-range breakout, hold to close
time_of_day: range forms after the open; position held until the close
universe_filter: stocks gapping (up for longs; gap-down/short side also traded and was his main profit source); optional skip filters such as relative volume > 3 (one trader's rule)
conditions: stock gaps at the open
after the open, price forms a tightening/narrowing range (contracting bars)
entry_trigger: buy stop above the range high (sell stop below range low for the short version)
stop: other side of the tightening range
target_or_exit: hold all day; exit at the close (no partials - partials tested worse)
management: fixed dollar risk per trade; shares = risk / range width so tight ranges give large size
stated_edge: Contraction after a gap precedes expansion; tight ranges give large R multiples on small moves.
stated_stats: automation scaled to ~3000 trades/yr with ~5x the profit of discretionary year (~300 trades)
mcf_translation: 5-min (or 1-min) bars: universe |gap| > 3%, price > $5, ADV > 500k; from 09:30 build opening range over first N bars (N=3-6) and require it to narrow (each bar range < previous, or last 3-bar range < 50% of first bar range); place stop-entry at range high (gap-up) / range low (gap-down); stop at opposite side; exit at 15:55; risk 0.25% per trade; test both sides and skip filters (rvol>3, gap size) systematically; avoid same-bar stop ambiguity by assuming stop hit first.
